title: The Transformer Architecture
description: Attention mechanisms. How Claude sees meaning.

title: Hallucination & Confidence
description: Why Claude makes things up. How to spot it.

title: Context & Limitations
description: Token limits, knowledge cutoff, working memory.

title: Prediction, Not Thinking
description: Describe next-token prediction and what follows from it — the single mechanism behind fluent answers, confident fabrication, and everything in between.

title: Where the Behaviour Comes From
description: Explain how training shapes what a model says, including its biases and refusals — pre-training, fine-tuning, and human feedback, each leaving its own fingerprint.

title: The Context Window
description: Understand what the model can see at any moment, and what it has lost — size limits, position effects, and what memory features actually do.

title: The Settings That Change the Output
description: Use temperature, length and system instructions deliberately — matching each setting to what a specific task actually needs rather than leaving everything at default.

title: Different Models, Different Jobs
description: Choose between models on evidence rather than on which one you heard of — size, cost, benchmarks, and local versus hosted, each weighed against a real task.
